title: Procedural Memory / Human-Governed Skill Registry

control_plane.worktree_status_before_certification_art: modified only by G8 implementation and this artifact
control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The repaired read-only repository-agent proof passed without per_user_worktree_quota. The bounded mutating delegation remained deterministically blocked by the stale promotion target (zetsu_agent_apply_target_not_clean); local implementation was used under the documented fallback, and the production control-plane checkout was not modified.

implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore exposes one shared SkillRegistry and advisory selection/activation-packet adapters; no Zetsu-only implementation path was added.
stored_fields: required bounded tools and deterministic verifiers
source kind, URI, immutable revision, license, author and model-generation flag
validation, human approval, deactivation and rollback metadata
content hash and atomic registry revision
security_boundaries: Skill text is advisory data; no skill file, support script, tool name or verifier is executed by the registry.
Only the bounded ACI and deterministic retrieval/verifier tool names are accepted as requirements.
Authority, policy and project-rule override language is rejected; activation packets explicitly deny override, authority grant and execution.
Scope mismatch, malformed versions, source traversal, symlinked skill sources, duplicate versions and ambiguous equal triggers fail closed.
Model-generated records are always registered as candidates and require deterministic validation, frozen A/B evidence and explicit human approval before activation.

security_and_negative.bandit_note: Bandit returned zero high-severity findings; no executable subprocess or dynamic evaluation was introduced by the registry.

comparison.method: Frozen deterministic fixture tasks compared candidate-with-skill and no-skill arms through record_ab_test; correctness was required and both efficiency/reliability deltas were required to be positive before human approval. The no-skill control and ambiguous/negative trigger controls were also executed.

controlled_ab_observation.interpretation: Controlled fixture evidence for the registry gate only; not a production model latency, token, throughput or GPU measurement.

comparison.reason: The registry is production-safe as an explicit shared capability, but no bundled skill is activated by default and no real local-model task benefit was measured. Human-approved activation remains opt-in and scoped.

limitations: The coordinator does not automatically inject registry-selected skills into model prompts; Core exposes the governed API so future adapters cannot bypass it.
The controlled A/B numbers are fixture evidence for lifecycle enforcement, not hardware or model performance claims.
ai4s-skills is recorded at the exact upstream pinned short revision 2519e8d because the source release record exposes that immutable short SHA; it was not treated as a mutable branch reference.
The existing FrozenSkillRegistry remains the run-reproducibility lock for the legacy team runner; G8 SkillRegistry governs version lifecycle and activation separately.
The full G0 certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the selected unchanged suite passed under that permission.

rollback_target.description: G7-certified shadow ContextPlanner with G6-G1 capabilities; production/v1 remains separately immutable.
